qualification_harness.cmake_source:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(FilesLocationValues LANGUAGES CXX)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${SOURCE}" SOURCE)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${SDK}" SDK)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
include("${SOURCE}/cmake/CkToolsStrict.cmake")
if(MSVC)
 set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
 add_compile_options(/fsanitize=address)
 add_link_options(/DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO)
else()
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
add_executable(location_values
 "${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files/native_name.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files/native_path.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files/windows_name.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files/unicode_scalar.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location_text.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_location_draft.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/tests/files_location_text_tests.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/tests/files_location_draft_tests.cpp"
 "${SOURCE}/src/vision/host/cktest_main.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(location_values PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files" "${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" "${SDK}/include")
cktools_strict(location_values)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME location_values COMMAND location_values)
set_tests_properties(location_values PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)

timing_and_freshness.scope: Initial normal build compiled eight C++ units and linked twice; final test-only fixture correction compiled one unit and relinked. Prior dialog final test-only build was 8.271 seconds; current final build 4.201 seconds. Actual compiled inputs/object/output hashes establish freshness. The new ten-unit UI-free sanitizer harness has no comparable prior duration baseline; these runs establish its first baseline. Full 82-unit instrumented UI builds are not presented as comparable timing or repeated for this value-only change. No thread, native I/O, index, UI-controller or SDK binary source changed; no new race/production-window acceptance is claimed.

review.semantics: Explicit syntax/encoding; exact native-unit prefixes, bounded absolute parents and literal components. Typed escape lexemes retained. Complete proposals validate names, budgets and full parse; ExactNames additionally proves exact route equality. Path refuses unrepresentable/ambiguous names instead of changing format.
review.limits: Text/native/depth bounds checked before future discovery. Partial navigation prefixes may match longer valid names but cannot become navigation components. Complete anchors required; no cwd/root/home/environment fallback. No native discovery, scan, object authority or filesystem mutation in this layer.
review.excluded: Initial deep-route test used the round-trip helper default depth 1024 instead of its explicit 4096 test limit. Passing that same limit to the helper corrected the fixture; product source was unchanged by the correction. Only final frozen source qualifies.
review.remaining: WP-02 remains open for native completion directory/index matching, asynchronous revisions/lifetime gating, ckVision provider/Right-to-accept integration, history/bookmarks, qualified refresh, properties/preview, production executable and interactive acceptance.
